suppress.notes: False positive (CPE mismatch), reviewed 2026-10-11 against run 38126683173. Package: pkg:maven/androidx.sqlite/sqlite-android@2.7.1 and pkg:maven/androidx.sqlite/sqlite-framework-android@2.7.1. Matched CPE: cpe:2.3:a:sqlite:sqlite:2.7.1, i.e. the androidx library version 2.7.1 read as SQLite 2.7.1. These artifacts are Kotlin/Java API layers (SupportSQLite interfaces and the adapter over android.database.sqlite); they contain no SQLite C code and no native library. Where SQLite actually runs in the release APK: 1. The app database: Room opens it through net.zetetic:sqlcipher-android 4.19.1 (SupportOpenHelperFactory in core/data CeteleDatabaseFactory). Its libsqlcipher.so (all four ABIs) bundles SQLite 3.53.4, source id 2026-07-24 19:02:57 bf7c7f30..., read from the native library of the AAR. Every listed CVE has an NVD affected range that ends below 3.53.4; the newest are CVE-2026-11822 and CVE-2026-11824 (FTS5, < 3.53.2), CVE-2025-70873 (zipfile, < 3.51.1), CVE-2025-6965 (< 3.50.2), CVE-2023-7104 (<= 3.43.0), CVE-2022-35737 (< 3.39.2); the others end at 3.32.3 or older. None applies to 3.53.4. 2. sqlite-framework (used by androidx libraries such as WorkManager for their own small database) calls the SQLite of the Android platform, which is part of the OS image, updated by the OS and not shipped in the APK. The APK ships no other SQLite: androidx.sqlite:sqlite-bundled is a test dependency only. Recheck when sqlcipher-android or androidx.sqlite changes, or when a SQLite CVE affects 3.53.4.

False positive (CPE mismatch), reviewed 2026-10-11 against run 38126683173. Package: pkg:maven/org.jetbrains.compose.runtime/runtime-android@1.12.0 and pkg:maven/org.jetbrains.compose.runtime/runtime-saveable-android@1.12.0 (Compose runtime Kotlin libraries). Matched CPE: cpe:2.3:a:jetbrains:runtime:1.12.0. CVE-2025-29903 (NVD CVSS 3.1 7.8) is for JetBrains Runtime, the JDK build shipped with JetBrains IDEs (affected: JetBrains Runtime before 21.0.6b872.80, insecure macOS flags allowing dynamic library loading). JetBrains Runtime is not part of the APK and does not run on Android; the Compose runtime artifact only shares the word "runtime" in its name.
